name: Roper Buy It Now Button for WooCommerce
author: roper

sections.description:
Roper Buy It Now Button for WooCommerce adds a “Buy It Now” button to your product pages, allowing customers to bypass the shopping cart and proceed directly to checkout. This streamlines the purchasing process and can help increase conversion rates.

Features

  • Add buy it now button to all product types
  • Customizable button text
  • AJAX-powered smooth checkout flow
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Fully translatable
  • No external services – everything runs locally
  • 100% free – no premium version or locked features
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/roper-buy-it-now-button, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Roper Buy It Now to customize button text
  4. The buy it now button will automatically appear on product pages
sections.faq:
Can I change the button text?

Yes, you can change the button text in WooCommerce Settings > Products > Roper Buy It Now.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, customers must select product variations before clicking the Buy It Now button.

Does this plugin call any external services?

No. This plugin runs entirely on your WordPress installation and does not connect to any external APIs or services.
